description: Live verification of natural-language size/age comparison file search on the real physical Android phone, against its real files. Expectations are deliberately loose (this phone's real file set is unknown in advance) — the point is to capture and manually read the real answer, tool trace and file count from the report, not to assert a predicted filename.

cases.query: which video takes the most space?
how many images are in DCIM
what is the largest file in Downloads?
